value: Quillfern Outfitters sells outdoor and home goods online, with its own Quillridge, Fernpath, Emberhollow, Mothdown and Fernglow lines.
Support is open Monday to Saturday, 8:00 to 20:00 Eastern.
The return window is 30 days from delivery for unused items.
Opened electronics can be returned within 14 days of delivery.
The return label fee is 6 dollars, waived for defects.
Standard shipping is free on orders over 75 dollars.
Standard shipping takes 3 to 6 business days.
Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days.
Price adjustments are honoured within 7 days of purchase.
Tents and packs carry a 2 year warranty.
Emberhollow cast iron carries a lifetime warranty.
Refunds arrive in 5 business days after they are issued.
Only orders in processing status can be cancelled.
Cancellations and refunds always need a human approval before they run.
Customer asked to be told when the Quillridge tent passes the sort hub. Prefers short replies.
Customer reported the lantern arrived with a cracked lens and wants money back, not a replacement.
Customer is considering returning the cookware set because the lid is too small for their stove.
Customer ordered the 45L pack by mistake and wants the 55L instead.
Customer asked about the tent warranty after a pole bent on a camping trip.
Gift cards never expire and cannot be refunded to cash.
